approved_by_description: #20 The Unmeasured Distance — gold strand across blue and magenta skies
#08 The Last Procession — Dominion sacrifice; exact image confirmed by the creator
removed_scope: Other images in the 2026-11-05 campaign batch are non-canon and removed from the active collection. Ambrel receives only the specifically requested bridge correction, kept as a non-canon working revision.
feedback: Both maps rejected: scale and conventional pictorial tree/building symbols feel wrong.
World is emerging from a dark age, established and potentially optimistic, but not cosmopolitan; previous batch leaned toward Arcane-like social mixing.
Populations should follow local community and faction context. Do not distribute every human ethnicity or fantasy people through every scene.
Orcs are not Vigil / white aligned.
Lion folk are overused; they generally keep to themselves.
Stop repeating water-infrastructure scenes. Alderkin do not always help people and are not default civic workers.
Dominion's city should be much worse and less mixed; the second Dominion setting is closer to the intended mood.
The red camp is liked in concept, but its crowd is too mixed and the image is not canon.

Characters should be somewhat more attractive than real life on average, with individuality, imperfections and wear. They are currently too uniformly perfect; the creator clarified that this, not simply waxy texture, is the main concern.
Only the gold-strand cosmology and Dominion sacrifice are approved from this batch.
